  t.payment_method, 
  u.risk_level, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate
FROM 
  transactions t 
JOIN 
  users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE 
  t.status = 'FAILED' 
  AND u.account_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
  t.payment_method, 
  u.risk_level

       SUM(CASE WHEN t.instrument = 'GOOG' THEN t.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount_usd) AS goog_ratio,

)
